scope: HeardRight and ScrapeRight FFmpeg behavior before rightkit-ffmpeg extraction

heardright.attribution: Generated ffmpeg-LICENSE.txt summary/link only; no complete LGPL text or immutable build manifest is staged by stage-ffmpeg.mjs.

scraperight.attribution: scripts/third-party-manifest.json resolves FFmpeg as LGPL-2.1-or-later and build-third-party-licenses.mjs includes the vendored full LGPL-2.1 text.

gaps.evidence: Both stage arbitrary override paths and inspect -version, but neither compares SHA-256 with an approved manifest.
gaps.closure: Right Release must select an immutable catalog entry and rightkit-ffmpeg must verify SHA-256 before execution/staging.

gaps.evidence: stage-ffmpeg.mjs does not reject a non-zero/null spawnSync status before logging license check passed.
gaps.closure: Reject launch errors and every non-zero -version exit before license classification.

gaps.evidence: Both packagers infer LGPL only from the absence of --enable-gpl/--enable-nonfree; they do not require an approved build identity/configuration.
gaps.closure: Require approved digest, expected version/configuration, and reject forbidden flags case-insensitively.

gaps.evidence: HeardRight returns ffmpeg/ffmpeg.exe after bundled resolution fails; ScrapeRight engine extraction falls back to ffmpeg when its injected path is absent.
gaps.closure: Installed builds must fail closed to a verified bundled artifact; development PATH use must be explicit and verified.

gaps.evidence: decode_to_16k_mono uses blocking Command.output without cancellation, timeout, or owned-child termination.
gaps.closure: Adopt shared cancellable timeout-bound child ownership.

gaps.evidence: ScrapeRight polls cancellation and kill/waits the direct child, but has no deadline and no process-tree/group termination.
gaps.closure: Adopt rightkit-child-process deadline and tree/group termination semantics.

gaps.evidence: Only stale 7.1 hashes are documented; the Mac handoff explicitly requires 7.1.5 rebuild and verification.
gaps.closure: Build both 7.1.5 slices, verify configuration/decode/linkage, record hashes/provenance, then produce the universal artifact deterministically.

gaps.evidence: HeardRight stages a short generated notice linking to the license rather than the full vendored LGPL text required by the accepted plan.
gaps.closure: Stage the approved catalog provenance plus complete vendored LGPL notice/text through Right Release.
